pages.title: TNT
pages.text: The original TNT remains in the moving assembly, while another charge already burns. Reclaim that extra matter before it explodes, and a large pulse of aether remains.

pages.title: Putting It to Work
pages.text: Bring $(l)primed TNT$() into reach. After each capture, the device needs a long rest. It cannot capture while resting, paused by redstone, or full. Plan the timing and leave a safe outlet.
